claude.sample_unit: glomerular disease terms (paired general and tailored GPT-4 explanations)

links.outcome: Readability and PEMAT understandability of GPT-4 explanations, general vs prompted for 8th-grade level
links.effect: Grade level fell from 12.85 ± 0.93 to 8.44 ± 0.72; FRE rose from 25.73 to 60.75; PEMAT understandability rose from 60.7% to 76.8% (p<0.0001).
links.quote: Furthermore, we performed a PEMAT analysis to evaluate understandability ( Table 4 ), which demonstrated a notable enhancement in the understandability scores, increasing from 60.70 ± 8.46 for general explanations to 76.82 ± 11.39 for tailored explanations.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of GPT-4 patient materials with and without 8th-grade tailoring
links.effect: Average grade level dropped from 12.85 ± 0.93 to 8.44 ± 0.72 (p<0.0001); 25 of 67 tailored explanations still had FRE below 60.
links.quote: In contrast, the tailored explanations were designed for significantly easier comprehension, with an average grade level of 8.44 ± 0.72 ( p < 0.0001) ( Table 2 , Figure 1 ).

links.outcome: Accuracy of GPT-4 explanations simplified for lower literacy vs general explanations
links.effect: Accuracy fell from 4.56 ± 0.66 to 3.99 ± 0.39 (p<0.0001) when tailored to 8th-grade level; moderate negative correlation between readability and accuracy (r = -0.445).
links.quote: Additionally, there was a moderate negative correlation between accuracy and readability scores (r = −0.445, p < 0.001), indicating that improvements in readability tended to correspond with decreases in accuracy.

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of GPT-4 treatment explanations on 1-5 scale
links.effect: General explanations scored 4.56 ± 0.66 and tailored 3.99 ± 0.39; inter-rater kappa 0.671.
links.quote: The general explanation received a mean accuracy score of 4.57 ± 0.66, suggesting that these responses were nearly accurate and comprehensive.

links.outcome: Language appropriateness (reading level) of default GPT-4 output relative to patient literacy
links.effect: Default explanations averaged grade 12.85 and FRE 25.73, above average US reading level of 7th-8th grade.
links.quote: The readability analysis revealed that the grade level for general explanations averaged 12.85 ± 0.93.

unlisted_practices: Prompting an LLM to rewrite responses at an 8th-grade reading level to improve readability

openai.sample_unit: glomerular disease terms, each with general and tailored GPT-4 responses

links.outcome: Readability and understandability of tailored explanations
links.effect: FRE improved from 25.73 ± 6.98 to 60.75 ± 4.56; PEMAT increased from 60.70 ± 8.46 to 76.82 ± 11.39, p < 0.0001.
links.quote: The FRE scores also reflected this distinction; general explanations recorded a challenging FRE score of 25.73 ± 6.98, while tailored explanations achieved a significantly more accessible FRE score of 60.75 ± 4.56 ( p < 0.0001) ( Table 2 , Figure 2 ).

links.effect: Average grade level decreased from 12.85 ± 0.93 to 8.44 ± 0.72, p < 0.0001.
links.quote: In contrast, the tailored explanations were designed for significantly easier comprehension, with an average grade level of 8.44 ± 0.72 ( p < 0.0001) ( Table 2 , Figure 1 ).

links.effect: Tailored accuracy was 3.99 ± 0.39 versus 4.56 ± 0.66 for general explanations, p < 0.0001.
links.quote: The accuracy of GPT-4's tailored explanations was significantly lower compared to the general explanations (3.99 ± 0.39 versus 4.56 ± 0.66, p < 0.0001).

links.effect: Mean accuracy declined from 4.57 ± 0.66 for general explanations to 3.99 ± 0.39 for tailored explanations, p < 0.0001.
links.quote: However, explanations tailored for patients with an 8th-grade reading level or lower showed a reduced mean accuracy score of 3.99 ± 0.39 ( Table 2 ).

links.effect: Readability grade level averaged 12.85 ± 0.93 (upper end of high school) with a Flesch Reading Ease score of 25.73 ± 6.98 for general explanations.
links.quote: GPT-4's general explanations had an average readability level of 12.85 ± 0.93, corresponding to the upper end of high school.

links.outcome: accuracy of patient explanations tailored for lower reading level
links.effect: Tailored explanations had significantly lower accuracy than general explanations (3.99 ± 0.39 vs 4.56 ± 0.66, p < 0.0001; difference 0.57, 95% CI 0.46–0.69), with a negative correlation between readability and accuracy (r = −0.445, p < 0.001).
links.quote: The accuracy of GPT-4's tailored explanations was significantly lower compared to the general explanations (3.99 ± 0.39 versus 4.56 ± 0.66, p < 0.0001).
